charter.objective: Prepare and verify release artifacts through an accountable agent team.
constraints: Keep artifacts inside the project workspace
success_criteria: Every task has an assigned agent and a recorded result

agents.name: Project coordinator
agents.instructions: Coordinate the agreed scope and inspect the runtime before verification.

agents.name: Artifact builder
agents.instructions: Produce artifacts from the task specification within the project scope.

agents.name: Independent reviewer
agents.instructions: Check artifact contents against explicit acceptance evidence.
